channel.title: Consola Abierta — English edition
channel.description: Systems engineering, infrastructure and technical operations explained from the inside.

item.title: Designing a Disaster Recovery Test: How to Measure Service Recovery
item.description: Scope a DR exercise, measure RTO/RPO, validate dependencies and evidence. Includes an offline Python scorecard; it does not run failover.

item.title: LLM Benchmarking: TTFT, TPOT, Throughput and Reproducible Methodology
item.description: TTFT, ITL, TPOT and E2E; throughput, open/closed-loop load, percentiles, goodput, SLOs, vLLM, AIPerf, Prometheus and cost. Free trace-analysis lab.

item.title: Distributed LLM Inference: Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism and NCCL
item.description: Tensor/Pipeline Parallelism, NCCL collectives, Ring All-Reduce, GPU topology and multi-node serving. Reproducible CPU-only simulator using the Python standard library.

item.title: LLM Quantization: FP16, BF16, FP8, INT8 and INT4 from the inside
item.description: FP16/BF16, FP8, INT8/INT4 and NF4; scales, outliers, calibration, GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant and KV Cache. Reproducible CPU-only lab with no external dependencies.

item.title: Inside vLLM: PagedAttention, Continuous Batching and GPU Memory
item.description: PagedAttention, KV blocks, prefix caching and continuous batching. Reproducible Python-standard-library lab, CPU-only and free.

item.title: LLM Inference: Prefill, Decode and KV Cache
item.description: Prefill, Decode and KV Cache: inference phases, K/V reuse and memory sizing. Reproducible CPU laboratory.

item.title: How an LLM Learns: Next-Token Prediction, Cross Entropy, Backpropagation and AdamW
item.description: Autoregressive objective, Cross Entropy, gradients and AdamW. CPU-reproduced lab with two learning-rate policies and twelve checks.

item.title: Self-Attention Deep Dive: mathematics, gradients and modern variants
item.description: Q/K/V derivation, gradients, causal masking, MHA/GQA/MQA and RoPE. CPU-reproduced PyTorch lab with seven numerical checks.

item.title: Inside a Transformer: from tokens to a decoder-only LLM
item.description: A deep dive into embeddings, Q/K/V, scaled dot-product attention, causal masking, Pre-LayerNorm and next-token prediction. Includes a reproduced TinyGPT PyTorch lab.

item.title: SQL Server tempdb: diagnosing log growth caused by an open transaction
item.description: Reproduced SQL Server 2022 lab: ACTIVE_TRANSACTION, 26 log growth events, DMV diagnosis and rollback validation.

item.title: Windows Server under pressure: advanced CPU, memory, storage and network diagnostics
item.description: A reproducible Windows Server 2025 investigation covering CPU, memory, DiskSpd, ETW and guest-to-guest TCP with dedicated PerfMon sampling and documented limits.
